ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, C is a point on the semicircle O with AB as the diameter. Lines AC and BC are connected, and squares ACDE and BCFG are constructed externally on sides AC and BC, respectively. The midpoints of DE, FG, $\overset{\frown}{AC}$, and $\overset{\frown}{BC}$ are M, N, P, Q, respectively. If $MP+NQ=14$ and $AC+BC=18$, what is the length of AB?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} \\
Let's connect OP and OQ, \\
since the midpoints of DE, FG, $\overset{\frown}{AC}$, and $\overset{\frown}{BC}$ are respectively M, N, P, and Q, \\
therefore OP $\perp$ AC, and OQ $\perp$ BC, \\
thus H and I are the midpoints of AC and BC, respectively, \\
hence OH + OI = $\frac{1}{2}$(AC + BC) = 9, \\
since MH + NI = AC + BC = 18, and MP + NQ = 14, \\
therefore PH + QI = 18 - 14 = 4, \\
thus AB = OP + OQ = OH + OI + PH + QI = 9 + 4 = \boxed{13},

推理：连接 OP、OQ。设 OP 与 AC 交于 H，OQ 与 BC 交于 I。因为 P、Q 分别是弧 AC、弧 BC 的中点，所以 OP、OQ 分别是弦 AC、BC 的垂直平分线，因此 H、I 分别是 AC、BC 的中点。又因为 AB 是直径，所以 ∠ACB = 90°；在三角形 ABC 中，O 是 AB 的中点，H 是 AC 的中点，所以 OH 是中位线，OH = BC/2；同理，I 是 BC 的中点，所以 OI = AC/2。因此 OH + OI = (AC + BC)/2 = 18/2 = 9。

由于 M、N 分别是正方形外边 DE、FG 的中点，H、I 分别是对应内边 AC、BC 的中点，所以 MH、NI 分别等于正方形的边长，即 MH = AC，NI = BC。因此 MH + NI = AC + BC = 18。由图中位置关系，P 在 M 与 H 之间，Q 在 N 与 I 之间，所以 MP = MH - PH，NQ = NI - QI。于是 MP + NQ = MH + NI - (PH + QI)。已知 MP + NQ = 14，所以 PH + QI = 18 - 14 = 4。

又 OP = OH + PH，OQ = OI + QI，且 OP、OQ 都是半径，所以 AB = OP + OQ = OH + OI + PH + QI = 9 + 4 = 13。

method.method_draft: Trigonometric central-angle route. From the figure, let R be the radius of the semicircle. Let α be half the central angle subtending chord AC, and let β be half the central angle subtending chord BC. Because A, C, B lie on the same semicircle, the two central angles add to 180°, so α + β = 90°. Then AC = 2R sin α and BC = 2R sin β. For chord AC, the arc midpoint P lies on the perpendicular bisector of AC; if H is the chord midpoint, PH is the sagitta R(1 - cos α). Since the external square gives MH = AC, MP = AC - PH = 2R sin α - R(1 - cos α). Similarly, NQ = 2R sin β - R(1 - cos β). Add these two equations: MP + NQ = AC + BC - R[(1 - cos α) + (1 - cos β)]. The text gives AC + BC = 18 and MP + NQ = 14, so R(2 - cos α - cos β) = 4. Also AC + BC = 2R(sin α + sin β) = 18. Since α + β = 90°, sin α + sin β = cos β + cos α, hence R(cos α + cos β) = 9. Substitute into 2R - R(cos α + cos β) = 4 to get 2R - 9 = 4, so R = 6.5 and AB = 2R = 13.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中 AB 是水平直径，O 在 AB 上，半圆在 AB 上方，C 位于半圆弧上。AC、BC 分别为两条弦，并且在 AC、BC 的外侧分别作了正方形 ACDE 和 BCFG。M 在 DE 中点，N 在 FG 中点；P、Q 分别标在弧 AC、弧 BC 的中点附近，且 MP、NQ 画成从正方形外侧中点连向对应弧中点的线段。

推理：设半圆半径为 R。令弦 AC 对应的圆心角的一半为 α，弦 BC 对应的圆心角的一半为 β。因为 A、C、B 在同一半圆上，所以两段圆心角相加为 180°，即 2α+2β=180°，故 α+β=90°。

由弦长公式，AC=2R sin α，BC=2R sin β。

对弦 AC，弧 AC 的中点 P 在 AC 的垂直平分线上。若 H 为 AC 的中点，则 PH 是对应弓高，PH=R(1-cos α)。由于正方形 ACDE 的边长为 AC，且 M 是对边 DE 的中点，所以从 M 到 AC 中点 H 的距离 MH=AC。因此 MP=MH-PH=AC-R(1-cos α)=2R sin α-R(1-cos α)。

同理，对弦 BC，有 NQ=BC-R(1-cos β)=2R sin β-R(1-cos β)。

两式相加：MP+NQ=AC+BC-R[(1-cos α)+(1-cos β)]。已知 MP+NQ=14，AC+BC=18，所以 R(2-cos α-cos β)=18-14=4。

又 AC+BC=2R(sin α+sin β)=18。由于 α+β=90°，所以 sin α=cos β，sin β=cos α，因此 sin α+sin β=cos α+cos β。于是 2R(cos α+cos β)=18，即 R(cos α+cos β)=9。

代入 R(2-cos α-cos β)=4，得 2R-R(cos α+cos β)=4，所以 2R-9=4，2R=13。因此 AB=2R=13。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, C is a point on semicircle O with AB as the diameter. Segments AC and BC are drawn, and squares ACDE and BCFG are constructed externally on AC and BC, respectively. The midpoints of DE, FG, arc AC, and arc BC are M, N, P, and Q, respectively. If MP + NQ = 14 and AC + BC = 18, what is the length of AB?
raw_record.answer: Let's connect OP and OQ. Since the midpoints of DE, FG, arc AC, and arc BC are respectively M, N, P, and Q, therefore OP ⟂ AC and OQ ⟂ BC. Thus H and I are the midpoints of AC and BC, respectively. Hence OH + OI = (1/2)(AC + BC) = 9. Since MH + NI = AC + BC = 18, and MP + NQ = 14, therefore PH + QI = 18 - 14 = 4. Thus AB = OP + OQ = OH + OI + PH + QI = 9 + 4 = 13.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, AB is a horizontal diameter, O is on AB and is the center of the circle, the semicircle is above AB, and C is located on the semicircular arc. With AC and BC respectively as sides, two squares ACDE and BCFG are constructed toward the outside of the semicircle. M is marked near the midpoint of the outer side DE of the left square, and N is marked near the midpoint of the outer side FG of the right square; P and Q are respectively marked on arc AC and arc BC. In the figure, MP and NQ are along the direction from the midpoint of the outer side of the square toward the midpoint of the semicircular arc, and it can be seen that P is between M and AC, and Q is between N and BC.

Reasoning: Connect OP and OQ. Let OP intersect AC at H, and OQ intersect BC at I. Because P and Q are respectively the midpoints of arc AC and arc BC, OP and OQ are respectively the perpendicular bisectors of chords AC and BC, therefore H and I are respectively the midpoints of AC and BC. Also because AB is a diameter, ∠ACB = 90°; in triangle ABC, O is the midpoint of AB, and H is the midpoint of AC, so OH is a midline, OH = BC/2; similarly, I is the midpoint of BC, so OI = AC/2. Therefore OH + OI = (AC + BC)/2 = 18/2 = 9.

Since M and N are respectively the midpoints of the outer sides DE and FG of the squares, and H and I are respectively the midpoints of the corresponding inner sides AC and BC, MH and NI are respectively equal to the side lengths of the squares, namely MH = AC, NI = BC. Therefore MH + NI = AC + BC = 18. From the positional relationship in the figure, P is between M and H, and Q is between N and I, so MP = MH - PH, NQ = NI - QI. Thus MP + NQ = MH + NI - (PH + QI). It is known that MP + NQ = 14, so PH + QI = 18 - 14 = 4.

Also OP = OH + PH, OQ = OI + QI, and OP and OQ are both radii, so AB = OP + OQ = OH + OI + PH + QI = 9 + 4 = 13.
